newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Ireland's Stentor names Cruise O'Brien as new CEO.
newsitem.headline: Ireland's Stentor names Cruise O'Brien as new CEO.

text.p: Irish telecommunications company Stentor Plc on Tuesday named Patrick Cruise O'Brien as its new chief executive.
O'Brien, 28, was a founder director of Stentor and had previously been responsible for the company's corporate and regulatory affairs.
Stentor said in a statement that Cruise O'Brien was to replace Jonathan Friedel in the position.

The company said Friedel, 33, was to remain an executive director and would now deploy his technical skills to become Director of Product Development, a role newly created to exploit client opportunities.
Dan O'Neill, formerly non-executive chairman, will become part-time executive chairman, devoting around half his time to the affairs of Stentor, the company said.
